section: frozen intervention-point list (selected from baselines only)

selection_rule.intervention_point: first legal payable opportunity exists AND original greedy action there is HOLD
selection_rule.lifecycle_use: only to label exclusions of targets the tape never offered; never to pick
selection_rule.opportunity: first tape step where the target is actionable (sequential shadow gate: payable in transport order)
selection_rule.universe: candidate ids in the baseline tape plus lifecycle-discovered ids
